maddeler.e:
ارتجعن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَعْنَ (irtajaʕna) /ir.ta.d͡ʒaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# اُرْتُجِعْنَ (urtujiʕna) /ur.tu.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# اِرْتَجِعْنَ (irtajiʕna) /ir.ta.d͡ʒiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
